name: Slap
body:
School conjuration [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one stinging slap
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create a stinging slap against a single target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit your target.

The slap deals 1d6 hp nonlethal bludgeoning damage.
